summary.headline: Florentine Codex Astrological Chapters
summary.text: Continuation of the Florentine codex chapter list, covering divination about journeys, possessions, greatness, illness, captives, land purchases, war, marriage, and single combat, followed by Pythagorean and cabalistic tables. It also lists material on the elements, zodiac signs and their ruling days and hours, astronomy and horologia, Saturn, earthquakes, human constitution, pulses, the seven ages, theft divination, and Nikolaos Hydrouses’s stonecutter proem translated from Chaldaean Roman dialect.
